gaps: The front grille and chimney mouths read pale peach in the engine (front grille about sRGB 208, 164, 127) where the sheet shows saturated amber-orange: three.js AgX tone mapping desaturates F08C2C emission, and GLOW_STRENGTH is held at 1.0 (above the 0.7 convention) as a compromise.
The fists read as a row of four finger tubes from the front, a little comb-like; the sheet's fists are rounder, heavier mitts with a broad back of hand.
The head is smaller than the sheet's and partly hidden behind the top hoop from a low seated eye line; the side view shows no distinct face plate.
The legs (gunmetal thighs, brass greaves and sabatons) are slimmer and shorter-looking than the sheet's chunky armoured legs.
The arms hang close to vertical from the side; the sheet angles the forearms forward more strongly.
The walnut and brass are factor-only (no wood grain, plank wear or brass engraving textures); the barrel stays slightly lighter and warmer than the sheet's walnut in direct light.
The back reads as a walnut barrel with a small glowing grille and pleats; the sheet's back detailing (straps, vent plate) is simplified.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the five in-engine clip shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium launched with ANGLE Metal GPU flags; the WebGL renderer string was not retained, so the backend is unconfirmed). This pass rebuilt the body from the independent review's list: rounded layered brass pauldrons with emerald bosses as the widest shape at the shoulder line, gunmetal upper arms, big smooth brass cylinder forearms, huge brass fists hanging forward of the body near knee height, a six-pleat walnut bellows with a brass belt, emissive front and back grilles and chimney mouths (golem-glow), emerald inlays at shoulders, elbows and knees from COLOR_0, walnut staves and pleats instead of black rings, and smooth-shaded brass. Walnut colour was matched by sampling the engine idle shot: the barrel reads about sRGB (105, 68, 44) lit and (71, 45, 32) in shadow against the concept's about (84, 53, 34); the previous build measured about (140, 93, 64).

rubric.note: Much closer than the previous build. The arms are now long, with large cylinder forearms and big fists hanging near ankle height, and the barrel-on-short-legs gestalt with two chimneys matches the sheet. The remaining gaps are structural. The head is a small brass cap sunk behind the top hoop, where the sheet has a distinct dome rising proud of the barrel between the chimneys. The shoulders are round disc caps instead of massive overhanging pauldrons. The torso splits into a spherical dome over a narrower separate pleat cylinder, where the sheet has one continuous barrel whose lower half tapers into ribs. The arms hang vertically in the side view, where the sheet angles the forearm forward, and the gunmetal thighs are slimmer than the sheet's armoured brass legs.

Present: vertical brass barrel straps with a riveted waist band, an oval front grille, a back grille, two chimneys, walnut bellows pleats, emerald inlays at the shoulder, elbow and knee, and big fists. Missing or wrong: none of the glow signature reads. The front grille gap measures sRGB 211, 164, 126 in the engine idle shot against 254, 234, 52 in the concept. The eyes (about 208, 157, 112) and chimney mouths (about 207, 157, 115) are flat peach discs with no flame. The head and face plate are effectively absent, and the curved horizontal strap across the back is missing.

Smooth shading replaces the old facets, and the plank seams, riveted bands, grille bars and knee caps add believable detail. The walnut is a flat colour with no grain or plank wear, the pleats read as flat louvre slats rather than soft bellows folds, and the brass carries a noisy swirl texture that looks like brushed noise up close. The fists are a comb of four parallel finger tubes, where the sheet has rounded heavy mitts with knuckles and a thumb, and the feet are plain blocks.

The barrel walnut median measures sRGB 88, 59, 39 (#583B27) in the engine idle shot, essentially equal to the art bible's oiled walnut #583C26 and inside the concept's range (87, 56, 37 front left; 82, 53, 36 back). The brass hue and emerald accents fit. The concept's value hierarchy depends on a saturated amber core and eyes as the brightest point, and the model replaces that with desaturated peach, so the warm focal accent the palette calls for is missing.

At 2.6 m the golem fills the view and reads clearly as a heavy brass-and-walnut barrel brute, and the large forearms and fists now sell the crusher role. It has no glowing focal point to draw the eye, the face is unreadable, and the frozen shot looks like the idle material with no state tint.

topFixes: Make the core actually glow: drive the front and back grille interiors, both eyes and the chimney mouths with a saturated amber emissive that survives tone mapping (for example toneMapped false or a higher emissive intensity on golem-glow) so the engine samples near the concept's sRGB 254, 234, 52 instead of today's 211, 164, 126, and add the chimney flame wisps.

Build the head and shoulders to the sheet: a distinct brass dome with a face plate and two round eyes standing proud of the top hoop between the chimneys, and massive layered pauldrons that overhang the shoulders in place of the disc caps.

Make the torso one continuous barrel whose lower half tapers into rounded bellows ribs instead of a dome stacked on a narrower louvre cylinder, add the curved horizontal back strap, and replace the four-tube comb fists with rounded mitt fists that have knuckles and a thumb.
independentScore.method: Independent visual review by a separate reviewer agent that did not build the model. The concept sheet assets-source/concepts/golem-sheet-1.png was judged at native resolution against the low front, side, back and three-quarter Blender renders, the front, side and back compare crops, the owner review sheet and the five in-engine clip shots (seated player, 2.6 m), with 2x and 3x crops of the idle barrel and head made with Pillow. The author's fidelity-compare sheet and self-score text were not used for scoring. Colour was measured as the median sRGB of barrel pixels in the engine idle shot (box x 318-625, y 110-295, brass and grille pixels masked out by hue, saturation and green-to-red ratio), compared with matching patches on the concept front and back and with the art bible's oiled walnut #583C26. Grille, eye and chimney-mouth colours were sampled the same way. Rubric: silhouette and proportions 30, signature features 25, surface detail and material read 20, colour and value 15, readability at play distance in the engine shots 10.
